title: loopzero-build-cwts values
description: Schema for loopzero-build-cwts (ClusterWorkflowTemplates for Argo build pipeline). Per INF-G17.

cloneRunner.description: Image used for git-clone init step

sourceBucket.description: S3 bucket name for source bundles + build cache. Must match SOURCE_BUCKET env in loopzero-api.

cacheBucket.description: S3 bucket for the dependency cache. Empty keeps it in sourceBucket.

credentials.description: secret: keys from minio.existingSecret. irsa: the IRSA role of the workflow ServiceAccount.
